title: midcycle-onboarding-guild-checkin-sept15-2025
summary: Mid-cycle sync for the onboarding guild focused on current candidates, new joiner ramp blockers, buddy program tweaks, and a quick pulse on team load and morale.
notes:
Pulse: backlog of infra bugs + one on-call handover caused 2 engineers to push onboarding tasks out a week. Overall morale: okay, call it cautious-exhausted for a couple folks.

Interview debriefs:
- Candidate A (SWE-II, infra): strong systems reasoning, slower on coding probe. Recommended: proceed to hiring manager loop if manager comfortable with pair-coding ramp. Notes: asked about CUDA/QoS; candidate has toy experience but not production GPU infra.
- Candidate B (SRE): excellent incident postmortem examples, strong automation instincts. Concern: limited Rust exposure (we're slowly adding Rust in serving runtime). Hiring panel: green with conditional upskilling plan.
- Candidate C (Platform Eng lead): good cross-team leadership, ambiguous answers on rollout A/B experiments and metrics. Recommend another focused interview on rollout design + examples of tradeoffs.

Onboarding blockers (reported by new hires and buddies):
- infra-perms: delay for KMS access (ticket ENG-3389) taking 7+ days. Short-term fix: grant scoped test keys; long-term: automate KMS onboarding flow.
- local dev experience: Vagrant-based docs outdated; needs one new dev VM image + Docker fallback.
- training gaps: lack of short workshops on Redwood serving internals (KV cache, batching). Suggest 2x 90-min sessions scheduled monthly.

Buddy program: proposal to move from static 12-week pairing to rotating 2-week shadows plus a dedicated onboarding buddy for first 2 weeks. Benefits discussed: broader context for new hires, less burnout for buddies. Risks: context-switch for buddies. Vote: informal majority in favor; pilot for Q4.

Team health: noted several small wins (release-template improvements, reduced model-rollback frequency). Headcount pressure expected in Q4 hiring push — platform will prioritize SRE and infra SWE-II roles.

Open questions: 
- Do we need a formal SLA for KMS onboarding? (Marco to scope)
- Can we get a documented playbook for common infra flakiness for new hires? (Liz to draft)

Informal notes to self: keep debrief short and record decision on rotating buddies so hiring managers can mention in interviews.
action_items: Marco: scope KMS onboarding SLA draft by 2025-09-24 (ENG-3389 follow-up)
Liz: draft 'first-30-days infra playbook' and share with guild by 2025-09-22
Samir: schedule two 90-min serving runtime workshops (first session by 2025-10-06)
Jenna: run pilot rotating-buddy schedule for two new hires starting 2025-10-01 and report metrics (ramp time, buddy burnout) by 2025-11-01
Aisha: follow up with recruiting on Candidate C additional loop scheduling by 2025-09-19
hiring_pipeline_snapshot: Open roles prioritized: 1) SRE (2 reqs) — 5 candidates in onsite loop; 2) SWE-II infra (3 reqs) — 4 in take-home stage; 3) Platform Eng lead (1 req) — 2 in manager loop. Recruiting notes: sourcing remains healthy for SRE, harder for infra candidates with GPU experience. Target Q4 hires: 4-5 across platform.
next_steps: Pilot rotating buddy + metrics capture (owner: Jenna)
Finalize KMS onboarding short-term workaround (owner: Marco)
Schedule serving runtime workshops and invite new hires + buddies (owner: Samir)
Recruiter to schedule Candidate C focused loop (owner: Aisha)
